info.name: Vellora – Astro Match API
info.description:
# Astro Match — Phase 1 APIs

Astro Match compares two users' zodiac signs and returns a **compatibility score (0–100%)**, both signs, strengths and challenges.

## Quick start
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (local default `http://localhost:5001`; use staging for shared testing).
2. Run **folder 0** → creates/logs in two test users and saves tokens automatically.
3. Run any other request. Every request has **saved example responses** (open a request → *Examples*), so you can see the shape without running it.

## Auth
All `/astro` and `/profile` routes need `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (the `accessToken` from login). The collection sets it for you.

## Response format
- Success: `{ "data": { ... } }` (some also include `"message"`)
- Error: `{ "message": "human readable reason" }` with status `400` / `401` / `404`

## Endpoints
| Method | Path | Use for |
|---|---|---|
| PUT | `/profile` | save `dob`, `birthTime`, `birthPlace` (existing endpoint, new fields) |
| GET | `/astro/me` | own sign + which birth details are missing |
| GET | `/astro/match/:userId` | **Astro Match card + details screen** |
| GET | `/astro/compatibility?signA=&signB=` | sign-vs-sign score (no users) |

## Key rules for the UI
- **Score comes from the server only.** Never compute or adjust it in the app.
- `band`: `excellent` ≥85 · `strong` 70–84 · `moderate` 50–69 · `challenging` <50.
- `available: false` is a normal 200 response → show an empty state, not an error.
- `explanation` is `null` until the AI phase ships.
- `starSign` is now set by the server from `dob`; the star-sign picker in Edit Profile can be removed or made read-only.
- Birth time/place are private; other users' profiles never include them.

## Coming next (Phase 2)
Best Astro Matches list, Astro filter + sort in discovery, AI explanation text.

item.name: 0. Auth (get tokens)
item.description:
Run these first. They create (or log in) two test users — **A = Aries**, **B = Leo** — and save tokens + IDs to collection variables, so every other request works without copy-pasting.

Use a **local or staging** server. Don't run Register against production.

request.description:
Existing endpoint. **Change for Astro Match:** the server now reads the sign from `dob` and stores it (`starSign` + `sunSign`).

`dob` validation (new):
- format `YYYY-MM-DD` (an ISO string with a time also works; only the date part is used)
- not in the future, not before 1900
- user must be **18 or older** → otherwise `400 { "message": "You must be at least 18 years old" }`

Test script saves `accessToken` / `userId` to collection variables. Returns **409** if the user already exists; then just run the Login requests.

item.name: 1. Birth details (PUT /profile)
item.description:
**Existing endpoint `PUT /profile`, new optional fields.** Send only the fields you want to change.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `dob` | string | `YYYY-MM-DD`, not future, after 1900, 18+. Server recalculates `starSign` + `sunSign`. |
| `birthTime` | string \| null | 24h `HH:mm`, e.g. `"06:45"`. Local time at the birth place. Sets `birthTimeKnown: true`. `null` clears it. |
| `birthTimeKnown` | boolean | `false` clears `birthTime` (for "I don't know my birth time"). `true` requires `birthTime` in the same request. |
| `birthPlace` | object \| null | `{ name, latitude, longitude, timezone }`, all required. `timezone` is IANA (e.g. `Asia/Kolkata`); get it from your places/geocoding SDK. `null` clears it. |

**Response:** the full own profile (`data`). New fields in it: `birthTime`, `birthTimeKnown`, `birthPlace`, `sunSign`.

**Note:** `starSign` is now derived from `dob`. A `starSign` sent without `dob` is ignored.

Birth time/place are **private**: they only appear in the user's own profile, never in other users' profiles.

request.description:
Signed-in user's astro profile. Use it for the "Your sign" section and to prompt users to complete birth details.

**Response `data`:**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `available` | `true` when a sign can be calculated (needs DOB) |
| `chart.sunSign` | lowercase sign key: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces |
| `chart.sunSignLabel` | display name, e.g. `"Aries"` |
| `chart.element` | `fire` \| `earth` \| `air` \| `water` |
| `chart.modality` | `cardinal` \| `fixed` \| `mutable` |
| `birthDetails` | saved `dob`, `birthTime`, `birthTimeKnown`, `birthPlace` |
| `missing.required` | fields needed for any score (only `dob`) |
| `missing.optional` | fields that will improve accuracy later (`birthTime`, `birthPlace`) |
| `completeness` | `incomplete` (no DOB) \| `basic` (DOB only) \| `full` (DOB + time + place) |

Suggested UI: show a "Add birth time & place for a more accurate match" prompt when `completeness` is `basic`.

response.name: 200 OK

| `chart.sunSign` | lowercase sign key: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces |
| `chart.sunSignLabel` | display name, e.g. `"Aries"` |
| `chart.element` | `fire` \| `earth` \| `air` \| `water` |
| `chart.modality` | `cardinal` \| `fixed` \| `mutable` |
| `birthDetails` | saved `dob`, `birthTime`, `birthTimeKnown`, `birthPlace` |
| `missing.required` | fields needed for any score (only `dob`) |
| `missing.optional` | fields that will improve accuracy later (`birthTime`, `birthPlace`) |
| `completeness` | `incomplete` (no DOB) \| `basic` (DOB only) \| `full` (DOB + time + place) |

Suggested UI: show a "Add birth time & place for a more accurate match" prompt when `completeness` is `basic`.

request.description:
**Main Astro Match API.** Use it for the Astro Match card on a profile (F1–F3) and the compatibility details screen (F4–F5).

`:userId` = the other user's `id`.

**Response `data` when `available: true`:**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `score` | integer 0–100 — show as `87%`. Same value for both users, always. |
| `band` | `excellent` (85+) \| `strong` (70–84) \| `moderate` (50–69) \| `challenging` (<50) — use for colour/label |
| `me` / `other.chart` | `sunSign`, `sunSignLabel`, `element`, `modality` for each user |
| `other.userId`, `other.name` | the other user |
| `breakdown` | how the score was built: `aspect` (60%), `element` (25%), `modality` (15%), each with its own score |
| `strengths[]` | `{ key, label }` — show `label`; `key` is stable if you want your own icons/copy |
| `challenges[]` | `{ key, label }` — always at least one item |
| `explanation` | `null` for now. AI text arrives in a later phase; show nothing or a placeholder when null. |
| `method`, `algorithmVersion` | `"sun_sign"`, `"1.0"` — informational |

**`available: false`** (HTTP 200, not an error) means one user has no DOB. Show an empty state (F8). `missing.me` / `missing.other` say whose data is missing — if `missing.me` has `dob`, prompt the user to add it.

**Errors:** `400` invalid id or your own id · `404` user doesn't exist, is blocked (either way), banned, inactive, or incognito and not matched with you · `401` missing/expired token. All errors look like `{ "message": "..." }`.
